Initial release of infant blanket kick detection skill.

- Real-time analysis of infant blanket coverage and kicking motion using night-time overhead camera.
- Sends alerts if blanket coverage falls below a preset threshold or after detecting blanket-slipping kicks.
- Supports integration with smart home devices to adjust room temperature or send notifications to parents.
- Enforces strict open-id acquisition process before analysis or report queries.
- Provides structured visual-only reports without medical advice; privacy and consent emphasized.
